summary: Pass admission policy: entry/exit semantics over occurrence ids

comments.body:
<!-- sdlc:stage=backlog kind=summary -->
Spawned by TKT-73 / ADR-025 (admission lifecycle events and offline reconciliation). The ADR's decision statements are binding constraints on this ticket.

description: Implement ADR-005's re_entry_policy (multi / count_limited, max_entries, requires_exit) in access using the repeatable entry/exit event types and the occurrence-id protocol from ADR-025. redeemed stays absent for passes (ADR-025 §D1). Depends on TKT-84 (event types + uniqueness) and informs TKT-19. GATE-3 REVIEW ADDITION (ADR-025 §D2): pass reconciliation records factual entry/exit only; policy conflicts (e.g. requires_exit re-entry without prior exit) are DERIVED projections re-evaluated as late cross-device events arrive — alarmed conservatively and revisable, never minted as trail events.
